title: trial-ci red again on main since 4a0b9c3d (21:07Z): tests/test_intent._descends_from_base_tip returns False for live hardening tip a01c72f in Actions (69 failures)
blocker: After PR #153 landed (trial-ci green at bb24d803 20:43Z), the hardening tip moved 9458b90 -> a01c72f (6 commits) and every trial-ci run on main from 4a0b9c3d on fails the same 69 Intent tests: `_living_tip('a01c72f')` -> False (63x), `_living_tip('9ce5c66...')` -> False (4x). tests/test_intent._descends_from_base_tip shells out to `gh api repos/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/compare/<BASE>...<sha> --jq .status`, first with the runner env, then with GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_TOKEN stripped; on Actions both attempts return non-zero/empty so the strict fallback is False. The repo is public and the same compare returns `ahead 6` anonymously from outside Actions (curl 200), so this is an Actions-runner transport/auth issue, not real drift. Sidecar b3c6 (author of #153) is actively pushing follow-ups to main (59070fc8, 9cbab824, 919d1c82...). PR #155's own CI run d84e5908 fails identically (its tree == main + inbox). CONFIRMED 21:35Z (review-assistance run bc-01a0e43c, comment on PR #155): `gh api` never falls back to anonymous — with no usable token/auth store it exits 4 before any request (gh 2.99.0, in or out of Actions), so the env-stripped retry is dead code on runners; and the as-is attempt fails because ${{ github.token }} is scoped to trial while the compare targets main. Meanwhile the gate jobs in the same runs classify 9458b90 -> a01c72f as DESCENDANT_OK via scripts/tip_drift_class (urllib, token then anonymous).
ask: Owner of tests/test_intent._descends_from_base_tip (b3c6): make the descendant check work without `gh` on the runner. Options in order of robustness: (a) plain urllib GET of the compare endpoint (anonymous first for the public repo, Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN second) instead of `gh api`; (b) git ancestry via a cached treeless fetch — `git init --bare $TMP && git fetch --filter=tree:0 https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main chatgpt/drive-github-hardening-20260919 && git merge-base --is-ancestor <BASE> <sha>` (this needs no token at all; ~0.3 s warm); (c) accept the live tip when scripts/tip_drift_class.py already classified it DESCENDANT for the same run. Diagnostic of what `gh api` actually returns under the Actions token is being collected on PR #155 CI (step '[diag NA-0009]'); results will be appended here. Mark RESOLVED when trial-ci on main is green for a commit whose live tip != BASE_TIP. APPLIED on PR #155 (branch cursor/needs-attention-inbox-7189): _descends_from_base_tip now calls tip_drift_class.classify(base, sha) and accepts MATCH/DESCENDANT/BEHIND (UNKNOWN -> False, strict). Verified locally with GH_CONFIG_DIR=<empty> GITHUB_ACTIONS=true and no/bogus token: a01c72f -> True, 9ce5c66 -> True, trial SHA -> False; full Intent suite 0 failed in that env. Resolve when a trial-ci run whose live tip != BASE_TIP is green (main after #155 lands, or b3c6 cherry-picks the same 10 lines).
